name: partambus-api-tests
description: Test API/HTTP PARTAMBUS dengan Postman + Newman

scripts.test: newman run partambus.postman_collection.json -e docker-test.postman_environment.json --reporters cli,htmlextra,junit,allure --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/api-report.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "PARTAMBUS API Tests" --reporter-junit-export reports/junit.xml --reporter-allure-resultsDir allure-results
